profile.headline: lifelong learner 📚 | a11y advocate 🧠
profile.summary:
You may find Jen fiddling with code and graphic design, re-watching The Office, dining at holes-in-the-wall, volunteering at local non-profits, or attempting to run as a form of physical activity. Jen also has just learned that she enjoys typing in third person and now wants to implement this in her day-to-day life.

"​'You miss 100% of the shots you don't take. - Wayne Gretzky'​ - Michael Scott" - Jen Nguyễn
